subject: SSO rollforward evidence & privilege curation plan
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@averycloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AveryCloud Security <security@averycloud.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:14:00Z
Subject: Request: SCIM/SAML delta + privileged role mapping for SOC2 audit

Hi Soojin —

We’re kicking off our SOC 2 readiness window and our auditors requested a short bundle of artifacts for tenant 'avery-prod':
- SCIM delta export (last 90 days) showing add/remove events and attribute changes
- Representative SAML assertion samples for interactive logins (including NameID and role/entitlement attributes)
- A mapping of privileged roles (console/admin roles) and the justification / owner for each (least-privilege statement)

Ideally we need a sampling of assertions and the SCIM delta by Friday 2026-06-04 afternoon PT. Do you have a preferred format or existing export we can work from? Also: any NDA/secure upload preference?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

— Samir
Samir Kapoor
Security Engineering, AveryCloud
samir.kapoor@averycloud.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@averycloud.com>
Cc: AveryCloud Security <security@averycloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM/SAML delta + privileged role mapping for SOC2 audit

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the artifacts you outlined. Proposed plan:
1) SCIM delta: export CSV (timestamp, op_type, user_id, attributes_changed) for the last 90 days. Marissa will pull a delta sample and a full schema README.
2) SAML assertions: we’ll include 5 interactive assertion samples (redacted PII where appropriate) showing NameID formats and role attributes. Rishi will produce these and include a short mapping table of attributes returned.
3) Privilege mapping: privilege-mapping-draft.xlsx with role name, permissions summary, business owner, and least-privilege justification. Vanessa will own curating owner contact info.

Upload preference: secure Google Drive folder (we’ll share a link) and — if you prefer — we can provide a passworded zip over your SFTP. We’ll redact user emails in assertion samples unless you need raw.

Timeline: we’ll aim to deliver the initial bundle by EOD 2026-06-03 PT to give you extra buffer before your Friday window. If auditors want verbatim logs instead of samples, flag that now.

Action items for us: I’m looping in Marissa, Rishi, and Vanessa to confirm scope and owners.

On Mon, Jun 1, 2026 at 08:14 Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@averycloud.com> wrote:
> Hi Soojin —
> 
> We’re kicking off our SOC 2 readiness window and our auditors requested a short bundle of artifacts for tenant 'avery-prod'...
>
> — Samir

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@averycloud.com>, AveryCloud Security <security@averycloud.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:20:00Z
Subject: Internal: action plan — SCIM delta / SAML samples / privilege mapping (AveryCloud)

Team —

Samir from AveryCloud needs a short evidence bundle for their SOC 2 audit. Target deliverable date: EOD 2026-06-03 PT. We need to coordinate to hit this cleanly. Details below.

1) Marissa — SCIM delta
   - Deliverable: scim-delta-sample.csv + schema README (CSV columns: timestamp, op_type, subject_id, attr_changed, old_value, new_value)
   - Scope: last 90 days for tenant 'avery-prod', sample limited to 500 events (mix of create/update/delete).
   - Redaction: redact email addresses to localpart@redacted.example if auditors request PII masking.
   - ETA: 2026-06-03 12:00 PT

2) Rishi — SAML assertion samples
   - Deliverable: saml-assertion-samples.txt (5 examples), plus attribute mapping table (attribute_name -> example_value -> explanation).
   - Include interactive login assertions and one SAML logout assertion. Mask any session IDs.
   - ETA: 2026-06-03 12:00 PT

3) Vanessa — Privilege mapping
   - Deliverable: privilege-mapping-draft.xlsx with columns: role_id, role_label, permission_summary, owner, least_privilege_statement, last_reviewed
   - For each privileged role (console-admin, billing-admin, service-deployer) include the justification and owner contact (email) or team.
   - ETA: 2026-06-03 16:00 PT

Operational notes: share drafts to the secure Drive folder I’ll create (link below) and mark any items that require non-redacted data. I’ll notify Samir once the initial bundle is uploaded. If anyone expects delays, flag ASAP.

Drive (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link
JIRA reference: JIRA-SEC-342 (use for tracking)

Thanks — let’s keep this tight.

— Soojin
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@averycloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AveryCloud Security <security@averycloud.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM/SAML delta + privileged role mapping for SOC2 audit

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the plan — that timeline works. We received the Drive share and downloaded the samples. A few quick notes after a first pass:
- SCIM delta sample looks good; we’ll request one additional field (sourceIP) if it’s available in the event stream. If not, we’ll accept current export.
- SAML samples are fine; for one role 'service-deployer' the assertion contains a composite role attribute and the auditors asked for a short note explaining how composite role -> effective permission mapping is computed.
- Privilege mapping draft: please include the date of last access review per role (column). Also, the auditor asked for the 'least_privilege_statement' to be explicit about default deny and exception process.

If you can add the sourceIP column (or confirm it’s unavailable) and a 2–3 sentence explanation of the composite role mapping we should be OK for this window. We can follow up with a deeper artifact set if they request live logs.

We appreciate the responsiveness — happy to do a 15-min call tomorrow if helpful to close the remaining bits.

— Samir
